review.summary: The three rigid native-gold placements occupy the exact prescribed footprints; 14 starting cells become 23, 32 and 40 with no full row or column.
review.first_frame: Full faithful source retained, with 14 starting board cells, all three trays, existing native shading/foliage, settings and 18/26/10.
review.state_fidelity: Left 3×3 lands at r6–r8/c1–c3, heart at r6c2. Right 3×3 lands at r1–r3/c6–c8, heart at r1c8. Middle eight-cell shape lands at r3c5; r4c3,c4,c5; r5c4,c5,c6; r6c4. Groups remain rigid, with no rotation or occupied-cell overlap.
review.final_state: Exactly 26 new cells, 40 occupied total. All eight green collectibles, both new hearts and every initial collectible remain in their expected cells. Targets stay 18/26/10. No row/column clears, next tray, collection flight, reward or win.
review.game_feel: Short pickup anticipation, continuous grouped motion, precise cell snap, brief small native-gold contact strokes, separate pickup/placement sounds and concise mechanics narration. Full camera/HUD remain fixed.
review.native_style: Existing golden bevels, shaded gems and native foliage remain. Source tray crops are scaled to the correct board size; no flat restyle or broad light ripple.
limitations: Local still-image animation, not original-engine gameplay or an implemented playable.
Small tray-to-board crop/bevel differences remain because the saved small tray tiles are enlarged.
Brown background formerly hidden by trays is reconstructed from observed source shading and blended at the edges.
The ending intentionally holds at the third snap before the runtime next-tray deal. Audio was not auditioned.
review.audio_review: AAC stereo 48 kHz, 12 seconds; non-silent narration/effects and zero clipped decoded samples verified. Not listened to.
review.paid_attempt_preservation: Paid Seedance clip, immutable result, quote/log data and before-local archive remain. Prior charge is 1,149 points; this local clip charged zero.
